title: Neuro-Symbolic Proof Generation for Scaling Systems Software Verification
note: LLM-guided best-first proof search over Isabelle proof states for seL4-scale verification - CPU-heavy search plus one-GPU model inference/fine-tuning, all user space. Concerns: the seL4 proof corpus and Isabelle builds are large and slow; the paper gives no URL in-line (repo located by search), so confirm it is the official artifact

title: Efficient Compactions between Storage Tiers with PrismDB
note: LSM key-value store with tier-aware compaction - user-space RocksDB-style engine on NVMe  GitHub + Zenodo artifact; concern the paper uses QLC+SLC tiers that must be emulated here

title: LatenSeer: Causal Modeling of End-to-End Latency Distributions by Harnessing Distributed Tracing
note: Offline, trace-driven modeling tool (Python) that estimates end-to-end latency distributions from distributed traces; no root, no kernel, no cluster needed for the core contribution. Concern: the repo also ships DeathStarBench setup scripts for collecting fresh traces, which would need containers; the released Alibaba/DSB traces avoid that.

title: Are Learned DBMS Components Robust to Workload Drift?: [Experiments & Analysis]
note: experimental study of learned DBMS components under workload drift with a reusable drift generator - learned systems benchmark - concern: no repo located

title: Aeris Filter: A Strongly and Monotonically Adaptive Range Filter
note: monotonically adaptive range filter with on-disk adaptivity structures, integrated into a key-value store - classic user-space storage artifact

title: FlashPS: Efficient Generative Image Editing with Mask-aware Caching and Scheduling
note: Mask-aware caching and scheduling for diffusion image editing - single-GPU serving system, artifact available, diffusion models fit in 24 GB

title: AdaParse: An Adaptive Parallel PDF Parsing and Resource Scaling Engine
note: Adaptive PDF-parsing and resource-scaling engine for building training corpora - user-space Python parsers plus a learned parser selector - concern: paper scales on an HPC cluster, so single-node runs need a reduced document set

title: Kangaroo: Efficient Lossless Floating-Point Compression via Dynamic Reference Selection
note: lossless floating-point time-series compression with dynamic reference selection - CPU-only compression artifact - concern: the located repo holds the datasets, the codec repo may be separate

title: Unearthing Semantic Checks for Cloud Infrastructure-as-Code Programs
note: Zodiac is a Python static/differential-analysis tool over IaC programs; runs entirely offline in user space with no cloud credentials for the analysis phase. Concern: detection quality rather than performance is the headline metric, and validating found checks against real cloud providers is out of reach here; topic fit rests on the other-userspace catch-all.

title: NeutronOrch: Rethinking Sample-based GNN Training under CPU-GPU Heterogeneous Environments
note: CPU-GPU task orchestration for sample-based GNN training

title: HyC-LoRA: Memory Efficient LoRA Fine-tuning with Hybrid Activation Compression
note: Activation-compression LoRA fine-tuning - explicitly targets single memory-constrained devices, 7B LoRA with 2-bit buffered activations fits 24 GB - Triton kernels, user space

title: This is Going to Sound Crazy, But What If We Used Large Language Models to Boost Automatic Database Tuning Algorithms By Leveraging Prior History? We Will Find Better Configurations More Quickly Than Retraining From Scratch!
note: uses LLMs and historical tuning artifacts to bootstrap existing DBMS tuners - ML-based tuning - local DBMS plus an LLM endpoint - concern: no repo located

title: Biathlon: Harnessing Model Resilience for Accelerating ML Inference Pipelines
note: ML serving system that trades feature approximation for latency under accuracy bounds

title: Athena: An Effective Learning-based Framework for Query Optimizer Performance Improvement
note: Learned plan explorer and comparator on top of PostgreSQL

title: CSnake: Detecting Self-Sustaining Cascading Failure via Causal Stitching of Fault Propagations
note: Fault injection framework that causally stitches single-fault injections to expose cascading failures - user-space instrumentation of JVM distributed systems that can be run as several processes on this host. Concern: target systems are distributed

title: DyTIS: A Dynamic Dataset Targeted Index Structure Simultaneously Efficient for Search, Insert, and Scan
note: Learned/CDF-assisted in-memory index compared against learned indexes - user-space C++, single machine, Zenodo artifact mirrored on GitHub. Fits the machine with no privileged features.

title: Reducing Activation Recomputation in Large Transformer Models
note: Selective activation recomputation and sequence parallelism in Megatron-LM - selective recomputation is a per-layer memory-versus-recompute policy that scales down meaningfully to one GPU with a small GPT - concern - the headline results use 530B models on 2240 A100s and sequence parallelism itself needs tensor parallelism so only the selective-recompute half is reproducible here

title: ASM: Harmonizing Autoregressive Model, Sampling, and Multi-dimensional Statistics Merging for Cardinality Estimation
note: Autoregressive-model cardinality estimator combined with sampling; single GPU is enough. Concern: no artifact found in GitHub search

title: How Does It Function? Characterizing Long-term Trends in Production Serverless Workloads
note: Releases two Huawei production FaaS traces (7+ months, 1.4T invocations) with loading/analysis notebooks; trace-driven scheduling and cold-start simulation studies fit the machine exactly. Concern: industry characterization paper - the artifact is data plus notebooks, not a system, so the improvement must come from a simulator or policy the team builds on top of the traces.

title: ServeGen: Workload Characterization and Generation of Large Language Model Serving in Production
note: Production LLM-serving workload characterization plus an open workload generator - a reusable artifact (traces plus generator) that is CPU-only and directly useful for driving any serving experiment on this machine. Concern - it is a workload tool, so an improvement project would have to target generation fidelity rather than a serving mechanism.

title: Samoyeds: Accelerating MoE Models with Structured Sparsity Leveraging Sparse Tensor Cores
note: Dual-side structured sparsity kernels on Sparse Tensor Cores for MoE models; the A5000 is GA102 and does support 2:4 sparse Tensor Cores. AE Available plus Functional plus Reproduced. Concern - MoE checkpoints must be small enough for 24 GB, so a scaled-down Mixtral-class or synthetic MoE is needed

title: Cackle: Analytical Workload Cost and Performance Stability With Elastic Pools
note: Elastic-pool provisioning policy mixing cloud functions and VMs - a scheduling/resource-allocation policy. Concern: the evaluation needs a cloud account; only a trace-driven simulation is feasible here, and no artifact was found in GitHub search

title: KVDrive: A Holistic Multi-Tier KV Cache Management System for Long-Context LLM Inference
note: multi-tier KV-cache management across GPU memory, host DRAM and SSD for long-context inference - tiering plus pipeline scheduling - arXiv preprint 2605.18071 - concern: no repo located, long-context runs need a small model

title: Breaking It Down: An In-depth Study of Index Advisors
note: open testbed implementing 17 index advisors; excellent reproduction or improvement base

title: Hierarchical Residual Encoding for Multiresolution Compression
note: Hierarchical residual encoding gives one compressed representation serving many accuracy levels - a compression/storage contribution, CPU only. Concern: no artifact found

title: GraphCSR: A Degree-Equalized CSR Format for Large-scale Graph Processing
note: Degree-equalized CSR format that cuts memory footprint and improves batch access; single-node evaluation is meaningful. Concerns: the headline result uses a 79024-node supercomputer and the only artifact link is an anonymous.4open.science repo

title: Efficient LLM Inference using Dynamic Input Pruning and Cache-Aware Masking
note: Dynamic input pruning plus cache-aware masking for memory-bound decoding - predictor-free, evaluated with simulated memory hierarchies so it runs on one GPU - concern: Phi-3-Medium at FP16 exceeds 24 GB, use the 7-8B configurations

title: Trinity: A Fast Compressed Multi-attribute Data Store
note: Best-student-paper; a succinct multi-dimensional trie (MdTrie) plus query algorithms, all a user-space C++ data structure and store. Fits 125 GiB RAM comfortably; comparison baselines (columnar/NoSQL stores) all install without root

title: Structural Designs Meet Optimality: Exploring Optimized LSM-tree Structures in a Colossal Configuration Space
note: LSM-tree level-capacity and run-count design space built on RocksDB; single-node NVMe; only limit is the 257 GB free disk for very large datasets

title: Torpor: GPU-Enabled Serverless Computing for Low-Latency, Resource-Efficient Inference
note: Serverless GPU inference with late binding and model swapping between host memory and GPU; core mechanism is per-GPU and the machine has 125 GiB host RAM for the model pool. Concern: paper used a 4-GPU node and API redirection depends on the CUDA runtime version

title: SelfTune: Tuning Cluster Managers
note: Reinforcement-learning auto-tuner for configuration parameters inside cluster managers - the released library is pure Python and C# and runs in user space - Concern: every evaluated target (Kubernetes VPA Azure FaaS DeathStarBench) needs containers or cloud so a locally runnable tunable system must be substituted

title: Breaking the Isolation-Freshness Trade-off: Joint Adaptive Storage Optimization for HTAP Systems
note: Adaptive row and column storage layout selection for HTAP implemented in TiDB; the mechanism is a storage layout policy. Concern: needs a TiDB plus TiFlash deployment which is heavy but can run as multiple processes on one host

title: Efficient, VRAM-Constrained xLM Inference on Clients
note: Best-matched paper on the list: pipelined sharding for CPU-GPU hybrid inference explicitly under a VRAM budget, built on llama.cpp, with an MLSys26 artifact repo and a Zenodo archive. The A5000 plus 125 GiB host RAM is exactly the target regime

title: Excalibur: A Virtual Machine for Adaptive Fine-grained JIT-Compiled Query Execution based on VOILA
note: Adaptive fine-grained JIT-compiled query execution VM; C++ single node, LLVM is conda-installable. Concern: research-grade build with heavy dependencies

title: L3: A GPU-Native Co-Designed Data Format for Learned Lossless Lightweight Compression
note: GPU-native learned lossless lightweight compression format with warp-cooperative decoding - compression plus GPU kernels, runs on one Ampere GPU

title: Sailor: Automating Distributed Training over Dynamic, Heterogeneous, and Geo-distributed Clusters
note: The improvable core - the search-space exploration algorithm and the runtime/memory-footprint simulator - runs entirely on one CPU machine, and simulator accuracy is itself a testable hypothesis. Concerns - the end-to-end throughput and cost claims need heterogeneous multi-node GPU clusters that do not exist here, so only the planner/simulator half is reproducible; the team must scope the project to that half up front.

title: BladeDISC: Optimizing Dynamic Shape Machine Learning Workloads via Compiler Approach
note: Dynamic-shape ML compiler; single GPU is enough to reproduce most kernels. Concern: large build, CUDA/TF/PyTorch version pinning against driver 535

title: Capsule: An Out-of-Core Training Mechanism for Colossal GNNs
note: Out-of-core GNN training that keeps computation on one GPU; designed for limited GPU memory

title: Centimani: Enabling Fast AI Accelerator Selection for DNN Training with a Novel Performance Predictor
note: Learned performance and memory predictor for DNN training - the model and its microkernel benchmarks are user-space Python and a predictor can be retrained and validated for the A5000. Concern: the paper validates across four accelerator types we do not have, and the repository looks like the anonymized artifact containing mainly microkernels, so completeness should be checked

title: Baleen: ML Admission and Prefetching for Flash Caches
note: ML admission plus prefetching policy for flash caches, trained and evaluated entirely offline on released Meta traces from seven clusters (traces and code at https://www.pdl.cmu.edu/CILES/). Simulation-only, CPU-bound, no root and no flash hardware needed; the A5000 is optional for model training. Ideal single-machine improvement target - policy, the "episodes" residency model, and the Disk-head Time objective are all swappable.

title: FB+-tree: A Memory-Optimized B+-tree with Latch-Free Update
note: Latch-free cache-optimized B+-tree; headline numbers use 96 threads, our 32 threads is a scale-down but the mechanism and the contention story are unchanged

title: Towards Systematic Index Dynamization
note: framework that turns static indexes into updatable ones; user-space C++ library

title: SPEEDEX: A Scalable, Parallelizable, and Economically Efficient Decentralized EXchange
note: Single-machine parallel batch transaction-processing engine in C++ whose 48-core numbers scale down naturally to 16 cores and 32 threads with no special hardware - Concern: the domain is a decentralized exchange rather than classic OS and the build pulls a large C++ dependency tree that must go into HOME

title: Sia - Heterogeneity-aware goodput-optimized ML-cluster scheduling
note: Cluster scheduling policy with an explicit trace-driven simulator (sia-simulator) in the artifact, which is exactly the "evaluated with simulators or traces" case the scope allows. Policy improvements can be tested end-to-end on one machine. Concerns - the physical-cluster half of the artifact needs a heterogeneous multi-GPU cluster plus AdaptDL/Pollux and is out of reach; only the simulator track is viable, which limits claims to simulated goodput

title: SLoRA: Scalable Serving of Thousands of LoRA Adapters
note: Unified paged memory pool for adapter weights + KV cache, adapter prefetch from host memory, custom batched-LoRA kernels; the paper explicitly claims single-GPU operation. Strong fit for a memory-management or admission-policy improvement. Concern - tensor-parallel experiments are multi-GPU and must be dropped.

title: cedar: Optimized and Unified Machine Learning Input Data Pipelines
note: Framework plus optimizer for ML input-data pipelines; local execution is the default mode and distributed workers are optional

title: Tela: A Temporal Load-Aware Cloud Virtual Disk Placement Scheme
note: Temporal load-aware placement of cloud virtual disks - trace-driven placement policy that can be replayed in a simulator; concern: no official repo found by GitHub/web search

title: HydraServe: Minimizing Cold Start Latency for Serverless LLM Serving in Public Clouds
note: Cold-start latency of serverless LLM serving - model fetch, safetensors loading and pipeline consolidation are all measurable on one GPU plus local NVMe. Concern - the placement and network-contention parts of the design need several GPUs and servers.

title: TempGraph: An Efficient Chain-driven Temporal Graph Computing Framework on the GPU
note: Chain-driven temporal-graph framework on one GPU with a Generate-Activate-Compute execution model - user-space CUDA; concern: no official repo found by GitHub/web search

title: MEMO: Fine-grained Tensor Management For Ultra-long Context LLM Training
note: Activation offloading and fine-grained tensor/memory management for long-context LLM training; concern - evaluated on a multi-GPU node, needs scale-down to one A5000

title: TeleRAG: Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation Inference with Lookahead Retrieval
note: Lookahead retrieval that prefetches IVF clusters from CPU to GPU under tight GPU-memory budgets; the single-query latency results are single-GPU. Concern: the multi-GPU prefetch/cache scheduler parts cannot be reproduced

title: Quant-LLM: Accelerating the Serving of Large Language Models via FP6-Centric Algorithm-System Co-Design on Modern GPUs
note: FP6/arbitrary-bit-width weight-only quantization kernels built on FP16 Tensor Cores, so they run on Ampere sm_86 with CUDA 11.8 - exactly our toolchain. Concern: the paper serves LLaMA-70B on a 40-80 GB GPU, so experiments must scale down to 7B-13B models on 24 GB

title: Smash: Flexible, Fast, and Resource-efficient Placement and Lookup of Distributed Storage
note: Object placement and lookup for distributed object stores using a space-efficient lookup structure instead of hashing; claims full placement flexibility with under 60 percent of the DRAM of Ceph/MapX. Core artifact is a self-contained user-space C++ library built with cmake and gcc 12 which the machine has. Concern - the paper's headline evaluation was run in a public cloud with multiple storage nodes, so a single-machine study would have to fall back to multi-process emulation plus data-structure microbenchmarks (memory cost, lookup latency, recovery time); the repo has no CI and was last pushed in 2021, so build friction is a real risk

title: TiLT: A Time-Centric Approach for Stream Query Optimization and Parallelization
note: Stream-query compiler and runtime - CPU only user space  Zenodo AE artifact

title: SkySync: Accelerating File Synchronization with Collaborative Delta Generation
note: Reuses storage-layer checksums to cut delta-generation cost; implemented by extending rsync and dsync protocols, fully user space. Client and server can both run on this host. Concern: the WAN numbers need link emulation, and tc/netem requires root - LAN/loopback and CPU-cost measurements are still fully reproducible.

title: nnScaler: Constraint-Guided Parallelization Plan Generation for Deep Learning Training
note: Search-space construction and plan generation for DNN training parallelization - the plan search compiler and cost model are user-space and can be studied on one GPU. Concern - end-to-end speedup claims need multiple GPUs so validation would rely on the cost model or single-GPU memory-saving plans

title: GlueFL: Reconciling Client Sampling and Model Masking for Bandwidth Efficient Federated Learning
note: Federated training framework built on FedScale that combines sticky client sampling with bounded-change compression masks - the evaluation is trace-driven FedScale simulation which fits one GPU - concern - the contribution is mostly algorithmic and the reported runs used a multi-GPU simulation cluster so rounds must be scaled down

title: CLM: Removing the GPU Memory Barrier for 3D Gaussian Splatting
note: CPU-offloading for 3DGS on a single consumer GPU - the paper itself targets one RTX 4090

title: Speculative Decoding: Performance or Illusion?
note: Systematic vLLM-based study of n-gram, EAGLE/EAGLE-3, draft-model and MTP speculative decoding, with a released vLLM fork and simulator - a clean reproduction-or-improve target. Concerns: the study's large-batch and large-model points need more than 24 GB, so the hypothesis must be re-tested at a smaller scale

title: RetroInfer: A Vector Storage Engine for Scalable Long-Context LLM Inference
note: Vector storage engine for sparse-attention KV cache with a GPU CPU wave buffer; the whole point is fitting long-context inference into limited GPU memory which is exactly this machine profile. Concern: paper uses an 80 GB GPU so contexts must be scaled down

title: Wax: Optimizing Data Center Applications With Stale Profile
note: Matching stale profiles to new binaries for data-center PGO; user-space compiler work. Concern: collecting fresh profiles normally needs perf/LBR sampling which is blocked, so the project depends on the shipped profiles

title: PLATON: Top-down R-tree Packing with Learned Partition Policy
note: Learned partition policy for R-tree packing - a learned component inside a spatial index; CPU only

title: Blink-hash: An Adaptive Hybrid Index for In-Memory Time-Series Databases
note: In-memory hybrid hash/tree index for time-series ingestion on multicore; C++ DRAM-only. Concern: paper's best numbers use a 4-socket server, we have 1 socket and 16 cores

title: Harvesting Idle Memory for Application-managed Soft State with Midas
note: Soft-memory abstraction that lets applications harvest idle memory for caches and memoization; released as a C/C++ user-space library plus a coordinator daemon, and a 125 GiB RAM machine suits the workload. Concern (important): the paper states the coordinator is a user-space daemon plus a privileged kernel module, and the repo contains a koord kernel module - loading it needs root, so cross-application memory rebalancing may not be reproducible and only single-application soft-memory experiments may work.

title: Toward Efficient Homomorphic Encryption for Outsourced Databases through Parallel Caching
note: Parallel caching of ciphertext computations to speed up homomorphic encryption over outsourced data - a caching policy question, CPU only. Concern: no artifact found; HE library dependencies need user-space builds

title: KACE: Kernel-Aware Colocation for Efficient GPU Spatial Sharing
note: Single-GPU spatial-sharing interference predictor plus a colocation policy - the whole mechanism targets one GPU, an unusually good fit for this machine. Concerns - artifact was built on a V100 32 GB with Docker; offline kernel-metric profiling uses CUPTI/Nsight, which on stock drivers needs NVreg_RestrictProfilingToAdminUsers=0 (root) - the released metric CSVs and the model-training/figure path do run without it. A5000 has no MIG, so only MPS-style sharing is reproducible.

title: Stream2LLM: Overlap Context Streaming and Prefill for Reduced Time-to-First-Token
note: Streaming-context scheduling and preemption for LLM serving with a Zenodo-archived artifact and public workload datasets. Concern: the design assumes prefill-decode disaggregated deployments, so reproducing it on one 24 GB GPU needs small models and two co-located instances

title: Performance Analysis of the Randomized SIEVE/CLOCK cache replacement algorithm
note: Randomized SIEVE/CLOCK with multiple access bits plus a mean-field model and trace simulations - textbook fit for a cache-policy improvement project and needs only CPU. Concern: no public repository found. I searched GitHub repositories for SIEVE CLOCK cache and the authors, checked Van Houdt's and Desnoyers' pages, and could not reach the ACM DL full text, so artifact status is genuinely unknown rather than confirmed absent

title: StreamDiffusionV2: A Streaming System for Dynamic and Interactive Video Generation
note: Training-free streaming video-diffusion serving with an SLO-aware batching scheduler, block scheduler and rolling KV cache; the scheduling core runs on one GPU. Concern: the near-linear FPS scaling claim depends on multi-GPU pipeline orchestration that cannot be reproduced here

title: cuJSON: A Highly Parallel JSON Parser for GPUs
note: Massively parallel JSON parser for GPUs; user-space single-GPU artifact

title: TVA: A Version-aware Temporal Graph Storage System for Real-time Analytics
note: Multi-version temporal graph storage engine with custom hashing and version metadata layout; single-node storage engine work with an open repo

title: FrozenHot Cache: Rethinking Cache Management for Modern Hardware
note: In-memory cache eviction/promotion scalability - pure user-space C++ library plus a trace-driven benchmark harness. Concern - the repo README asks for at least 32 physical cores per socket and around 100 GiB per NUMA node; this machine has 16 cores / 32 threads and 111 GiB free on one NUMA node so absolute numbers will be lower, and cache traces must be downloaded.

title: SALI: A Scalable Adaptive Learned Index Framework based on Probability Models
note: Scalable concurrent learned index built on LIPP; CPU only, 32 threads is a reasonable concurrency range

title: StreamBox: A Lightweight GPU SandBox for Serverless Inference Workflow
note: GPU sandbox for serverless DNN inference built purely on CUDA streams and user-space memory management - single GPU, no root needed, fits the A5000. Concern: needs a working serverless runtime and a CUDA version compatible with driver 535

title: Live Patching for Distributed In-Memory Key-Value Stores
note: User-space live patching of Redis processes; concern - built for a Redis Cluster, would need multiple processes on one host

title: 10Cache: Heterogeneous Resource-Aware Tensor Caching and Migration for LLM Training
note: Tensor caching, prefetch and migration across GPU, pinned CPU memory and NVMe, built on DeepSpeed offloading. The machine profile (1 GPU, 125 GiB RAM, NVMe) is exactly the tiering target. Concern - paper trains larger models than 24 GB allows, so model sizes must be scaled down.

title: Voyager: Input-Adaptive Algebraic Transformations for High-Performance Graph Neural Networks
note: Input-adaptive algebraic (reorder/fuse) transformations for GNN execution on one GPU; concern: no official repo found by GitHub/web search

title: SmartLite: A DBMS-based Serving System for DNN Inference in Resource-constrained Environments
note: DNN serving inside a lightweight DBMS for resource-constrained devices; CPU-only and scales down naturally

title: K9db: Privacy-Compliant Storage For Web Applications By Construction
note: MySQL-compatible single-node storage engine layered on RocksDB; user-space build, workloads are single-machine web-app benchmarks. Concern: the headline contribution is GDPR compliance, so a performance-improvement hypothesis has to target its storage organisation and query path rather than the compliance story.

title: LitePred: Transferable and Scalable Latency Prediction for Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search
note: Transfer-learning approach for DNN inference latency predictors (VAE sampler plus similarity-guided adaptation); models are small and train on one GPU, and code plus latency datasets are released. Concerns: original study spans 85 edge platforms and mobile phones that we do not have, so new-platform measurement is limited to the local CPU/GPU - work must build on the released latency datasets. Merge note: scout linked the subdirectory https://github.com/microsoft/Moonlit/tree/main/LitePred .
